description: Halara is a community-driven athleisure and fashion brand selling activewear-inspired pieces — exercise dresses, leggings, tennis skirts and skorts, pants and loungewear — at accessible prices with inclusive sizing, developed by an in-house fabric team and built around social-media feedback.

evidence.summary: CollabFeed's Halara creator program page states Halara runs an affiliate program joinable through ShareASale, Impact, Webgains, CJ or Admitad, paying 5 to 15% commission per referred order, paid monthly on net sales with a 30-day cookie, verified against the official page in September 2026.
Halara's Awin UK programme profile states verbatim: 'We offer a competitive commission rate of up to 5% to 15% for each qualified sale.' No statement about an earnings cap appears on the profile.

CollabFeed has tracked only 9 paid partnership posts for Halara from 8 unique creators across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, indicating a small tracked paid-creator footprint. A separate tracker (Sup) counts 469 creators collaborating in 12 months but explicitly includes organic posts alongside paid ones, so the paid-program footprint per CollabFeed remains low.

Rate conflict flagged: third-party directories report different figures by network — up to 20% on ShareASale/Admitad and 12% for influencers on Impact (ReferralRocket), and a flat 8% on GetLasso — versus the 5-15% range published by CollabFeed and Awin. The recorded 15% is the top of the network-published range; creators should confirm the rate inside their chosen network.

name: Halara

opportunity.title: Halara Affiliate Program (ShareASale / Impact / Webgains / CJ / Admitad / Awin)

reasons.compensation: Published 5-15% commission range across five networks plus Awin, paid monthly on net sales — the top of the range is competitive for fashion, though the exact rate varies by network.
reasons.contact_access: No published program contact email was found on fetched pages (CollabFeed masks it); access is through network applications only.
reasons.credibility: Large, well-known social-first athleisure brand with an established multi-network affiliate presence.
reasons.niche_fit: Athleisure and everyday fashion — exercise dresses, leggings, skirts — squarely in the fashion/fitness UGC try-on niche.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application today through six networks with approval typically within days.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A structured multi-network affiliate program aimed at influencers and content sites, plus a historically documented ambassador route with no follower minimum.

description: Cupshe is an international online fashion and beauty retailer best known for bikinis and swimwear, combining trendy designs with affordable price tags, and positions itself as a vacation brand: 'At Cupshe, vacation isn't just a place, it's a state of mind.'

evidence.summary: Cupshe's Awin CA merchant profile headlines 'Earn Up to 15% Commission on All Sales' with a 30-day cookie, while its Awin commission-groups page and UK profile state 'Earn 3%-10% commission on all sales' — an internal conflict; the recorded 10% is the top of the commission-groups range. No earnings-cap statement appears on any fetched profile.

The Awin profiles publish two affiliate contact emails verbatim: 'If you have any questions, please contact us by Email: affiliate@cupshe.com or lois@cupshe.com', and describe sign-up as 'free, easy and fast'.

CollabFeed's roundup of brands hiring creators under 25K followers lists Cupshe with creators around 22K followers running 'ready for pool season' try-ons and notes the summer window is when the brand actively casts — evidence the program recruits smaller creators, though no creator counts are published, so saturation is recorded as unknown.

name: Cupshe

reasons.compensation: Published Awin commission-groups range of 3-10% (with an 'up to 15%' headline on the CA profile) — mid-range for fashion, with the conflict noted in evidence.
reasons.contact_access: Two published affiliate contact emails (affiliate@cupshe.com, lois@cupshe.com) on the network profile plus a direct application route — top band per the rubric.
reasons.credibility: Established global swimwear e-tailer running regional programs across Awin (CA, UK, NL/BE) and CJ.
reasons.niche_fit: Swimwear and vacation fashion — highly visual try-on and haul content that fits fashion/travel UGC well.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open, free sign-up on Awin today with regional programs for multiple markets.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A long-running network affiliate program that actively casts smaller creators for seasonal try-on content per CollabFeed.

description: Lulus is an online fashion destination headquartered in Chico, California and founded in 1996, selling trend-conscious women's clothing with a chic edge — especially dresses for occasions from weddings to parties — at affordable prices.

evidence.summary: GetLasso's Lulus affiliate listing publishes 4% per sale via FlexOffers with a 30-day cookie. Other fetched sources conflict: Ascend Partner (formerly Pepperjam) is reported at 7% and Impact at 1-10% per sale. No earnings-cap statement appears on any fetched page.

UseSnippet states the creator route Lulus itself publishes is: 'Apply to Lulus Affiliate Program on Impact', with applications reviewed through the affiliate platform and aimed at fashion bloggers and influencers.

Sup recorded 611 creators collaborating with Lulus in 12 months and 1,350 total collaborations (organic and paid counted together) — a very large creator footprint, so saturation is recorded as high. The separate Lulus ambassador program has no application: representatives reach out to targeted influencers (NetInfluencer).

name: Lulus

opportunity.title: Lulus Affiliate Program (Impact / FlexOffers / Ascend Partner)

reasons.compensation: Published rates are low and conflict by network — 4% on FlexOffers, 7% reported on Ascend, 1-10% on Impact; the recorded 4% is the fetched FlexOffers figure.
reasons.contact_access: No published affiliate contact email was found on fetched program pages; access is through network applications only.
reasons.credibility: Founded 1996, headquartered in Chico, California, and one of the best-known US online occasion-dress retailers.
reasons.niche_fit: Occasion dresses and trend fashion — a core fashion UGC category for events, weddings and parties.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Affiliate sign-up is open via Impact/FlexOffers/Ascend, but the ambassador tier is invite-only with no application.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A structured affiliate program across three networks with a very large recorded creator footprint (611 creators in 12 months per Sup).

description: Founded in 2020, Cider is a global, trend-driven fashion brand reimagining online shopping by democratizing access to quality, affordable style; it translates viral social moments into everyday statement pieces on a data-driven, on-demand production model with less than 3% unsold inventory.

evidence.summary: Cider's official ambassador page invites creators to 'Share your favorite Cider looks on socials, and earn commission every time your followers shop through your affiliate links', with a three-step flow (get links, share, get paid) and a Join Now call to action. The page publishes neither a commission rate nor a network, and no earnings-cap statement.

UseSnippet corroborates an affiliate-style ambassador program with sales-based commission and no follower threshold recorded, and notes Cider publishes no PR email — the ambassador program is its creator route.

Marketing Brew reported Cider has run paid influencer campaigns in more than 10 countries and built its growth on social-first marketing. No creator counts for the ambassador program are published, so saturation is recorded as unknown.

name: Cider

reasons.compensation: Commission is confirmed on the official page but the rate is not published anywhere fetched, so it can only be learned on or after applying — scored conservatively.
reasons.contact_access: No published PR or program email; the only route is the ambassador application form on the brand's own site.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2020 and grown into a global social-first fashion brand with paid creator campaigns in 10+ countries.
reasons.niche_fit: Trend-driven, social-first fashion built around viral moments — a natural fit for fashion UGC and try-on content.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open Join Now application on the brand's own domain with no follower threshold recorded.
reasons.ugc_evidence: An official, always-on ambassador program on the brand's own domain paying commission on affiliate-link sales.

description: MESHKI is an Australian fashion brand founded in Sydney in 2013 by Shadi Kord and Natalie Khoei, which grew from an Instagram-led venture into an international online retailer built around glamorous styling and contemporary silhouettes — occasion dresses, eveningwear, bridal and bridesmaid styles, matching sets and knitwear.

evidence.summary: GetLasso's MESHKI listing publishes a 6% per sale commission with a 30-day cookie and a join route through FlexOffers. Rates conflict across fetched sources: Shopper lists 5-10%, while Sovrn Commerce states MESHKI's current rates 'could not be independently verified'. No earnings-cap statement appears on any fetched page.
Ragtrader reported MESHKI 'has worked with more than 2000 influencers to date' — a very large historical creator footprint, so saturation is recorded as high.

Sovrn Commerce maintains a MESHKI merchant listing (founded Sydney 2013) but notes its current commission rates through Sovrn could not be independently verified — creators should confirm live terms inside the network before promoting. No official affiliate page on meshki.com.au was found.

name: Meshki

reasons.compensation: A published 6% per sale via the FlexOffers route — modest, and other sources conflict (5-10% on Shopper, unverified on Sovrn).
reasons.contact_access: No program contact email on fetched pages (the brand's hello@ address appears only as a competition organiser contact); access is via network listings.
reasons.credibility: Established Australian occasionwear brand founded in Sydney in 2013 with international reach and a two-million-follower Instagram presence.
reasons.niche_fit: Glamorous occasion and evening fashion — strong fit for event, bridal-party and going-out UGC.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Joinable through network listings (FlexOffers/Sovrn), but with no brand-published program page, availability is less direct than an official application.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand has a long influencer-led history (2,000+ influencers worked with per Ragtrader) and live network affiliate listings.

description: Alphalete Athletics is a premium athletic wear and lifestyle brand founded by fitness influencer Christian Guzman, selling high-quality training apparel through its own store and regional sites, with its Alphaland gym and retail location in Missouri City, Texas.

evidence.summary: Alphalete's official application page distinguishes paid 'Athletes' (exclusive long-term partners on monthly compensation) from 'Affiliates' who earn commission on sales driven through their unique code; it states there is no strict follower minimum, that Instagram and TikTok are primary, and that review takes 7-10 business days. The official page publishes no commission rate and no earnings-cap statement.

LinkClicky's Alphalete listing (last updated March 2024) publishes the program on Impact at 5% per sale across all regions. Because the figure is dated and the brand's own page publishes no rate, creators should confirm the live rate inside Impact.

Beacons Universe records 314 creators posting about Alphalete all time but only 3 sponsored posts in the last 12 months — a very small sponsored-creator footprint relative to the brand's size, so saturation is recorded as low. NewCollab describes the collaboration type as gifted product plus affiliate commission, looking for around 500+ followers.

Alphalete's official FAQ publishes a partnerships route verbatim: 'We are always interested in exploring new partnerships & expanding our roster with Athletes and Affiliates… please email marketing@alphaleteathletics.com'.

name: Alphalete

reasons.compensation: Affiliates earn code-based commission — 5% per sale per the Impact listing — but the brand's own page publishes no rate, so the figure needs confirming in-network.
reasons.contact_access: A published partnerships email (marketing@alphaleteathletics.com) on the official FAQ plus a direct application form on the brand's own domain — top band per the rubric.
reasons.credibility: Established premium fitness brand founded by a major fitness creator, with its own gym/retail destination in Texas.
reasons.niche_fit: Premium gym apparel built by a fitness influencer — squarely in the fitness UGC niche, with Instagram and TikTok named as primary platforms.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application form on the official site today, no strict follower minimum, with a stated 7-10 business day review.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A structured two-tier creator system (paid Athletes plus commission Affiliates) with an open application and published recruiting language.

description: Mono B is a Los Angeles activewear and athleisure company established in 2009 in the heart of LA's fashion district — female-led, design-inspired and built on performance fabrics — selling fashion-forward athletic and leisure apparel, with a substantial wholesale side alongside its consumer store.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's Mono B listing (last updated March 2024) publishes the affiliate program on Impact at 15% per sale across all regions, with the join route into Impact. No program page exists on the brand's own site and no earnings-cap statement appears on the listing, so the live terms should be verified inside Impact.

Mono B's official About page states it was 'Established in 2009 in the heart of Los Angeles' fashion district', is female-led and design-inspired with performance fabrics. No Beacons, CollabFeed or NewCollab creator counts were found for the brand, so saturation is recorded as unknown.

name: Mono B

reasons.compensation: A published 15% per sale on Impact — the highest published rate in this group — though it rests on a March 2024 listing and should be verified in-network.
reasons.contact_access: No published program contact email and no on-site program page; access is through the Impact listing only.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 2009 with a real LA fashion-district base, but substantially wholesale/B2B-oriented, which tempers its creator-program credibility.
reasons.niche_fit: Fashion-forward activewear and athleisure fits the fitness UGC niche, though the brand's wholesale skew weakens the pure DTC creator fit.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Joinable today through Impact per the published listing, across all regions.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A live network affiliate listing exists, but there is no brand-published creator program or visible creator recruiting, so collaboration evidence is thin.

description: Established in 2012 as a category on Free People, FP Movement has been at the forefront of redefining activewear, introducing performance-ready styles that extend beyond the gym — its activewear for Hike, Run, Racquet, Studio and Ski bridges the gap between fashion and function, with 56 stores nationwide.

evidence.summary: Free People's official FP Movement affiliate page states: 'There's an easy sign-up process through Rakuten Advertising, or you can connect with us directly if you're already an established publisher. If you're approved, all sales generated from your banners and posts will receive a commission.' The brand publishes no rate and no earnings-cap statement on the page.

Third-party rates conflict and neither is brand-published: UpPromote reports Free People commissions 'generally around 3% - 4%' across Rakuten/CJ/FlexOffers, while Shopper lists 5-10%. The rate is therefore recorded as null rather than guessed.

OVO Talent's comparison notes FP Movement ambassadors are pro athletes — the ambassador tier is curated rather than an open creator pool — while the Rakuten affiliate program is the open route. No creator counts are published, so saturation is recorded as unknown.

name: FP Movement

reasons.compensation: Commission is confirmed by the brand but no rate is published on the official page, and third-party figures conflict (3-4% vs 5-10%) — scored conservatively with the rate recorded as null.
reasons.contact_access: No published program email; sign-up runs through Rakuten Advertising from the official page, with a direct route only for established publishers.
reasons.credibility: The activewear line of Free People (URBN), established 2012 with 56 stores nationwide — top-tier retail credibility.
reasons.niche_fit: Performance activewear across hike, run, racquet, studio and ski that bridges fashion and function — a strong fitness/fashion UGC fit.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open affiliate sign-up via Rakuten today; the ambassador tier is reserved for pro athletes and is not open.
reasons.ugc_evidence: An official affiliate program page on the parent brand's domain actively routing publishers into Rakuten, though creator-specific recruiting is limited.

description: Dagne Dover is a New York-based brand designing hyper-functional bags and accessories for work, travel and everyday carry, with an emphasis on thoughtful organization, durable materials and modern style.

evidence.summary: Dagne Dover's official affiliate page invites creators to 'earn up to 10% commission when your audience shops through your links' within a 30-day attribution window, paid regularly through LTK; applicants must have a public social profile, an engaged audience and an LTK creator account, with applications reviewed weekly. No earnings-cap statement appears in the page's FAQ.
Beacons Universe records posts from 515 creators all time for Dagne Dover, with 33 sponsored posts in the last 12 months — a large, active creator footprint, so saturation is recorded as high.

Directory figures differ slightly from the official page: Shopper lists 5-10% and Shopday describes commission as 'varies by partner', versus the official 'up to 10%'. A separate Partnerize content-partner program also exists per a Partnerize case study, so creators should confirm which route they are accepted into.

name: Dagne Dover

reasons.compensation: A brand-published 'up to 10% commission' with a 30-day attribution window and regular LTK payouts — solid for travel accessories.
reasons.contact_access: No published program email; application runs through the official page into LTK with a stated weekly review cycle.
reasons.credibility: Established New York bag brand with a documented affiliate operation across LTK and Partnerize.
reasons.niche_fit: Work, travel and everyday-carry bags — a core travel/lifestyle UGC category for packing and everyday-carry content.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application today via the official page, gated on a public profile, engaged audience and an LTK creator account.
reasons.ugc_evidence: An official creator-facing affiliate page with clear terms, plus 33 sponsored posts in the last 12 months per Beacons showing active creator collaboration.

description: Monos is a Canadian direct-to-consumer luggage brand founded in 2018 in Vancouver by three childhood friends, selling minimalist hard-shell suitcases, weekender bags and backpacks backed by a lifetime warranty on suitcases, as a Certified B Corporation balancing elevated design with thoughtful function and accessibility.

evidence.summary: Monos's official Brand Ambassadors page recruits fashion, family, and home and design creators located in the United States or Canada to capture genuine moments featuring Monos products, with sign-up routed through Aspire (monosau.aspireiq.com). No commission rate and no earnings-cap statement are published on the page.

NomadGear lists a 'Monos Travel Ltd. Affiliate Program (via Awin)' alongside its Monos review, confirming a network affiliate route in addition to the Aspire creator program; no rate is published in the listing, so the rate is recorded as null.

Beacons Universe records posts from 373 creators all time for Monos but only 2 sponsored posts in the last 12 months — a very small sponsored footprint for a brand of its size, so saturation is recorded as low. Note Aspire's case study says the long-term paid ambassador tier itself is curated and invite-based, layered over the open gifting/UGC channel.

name: Monos

reasons.compensation: No commission rate is published on the official ambassador page or the Awin listing fetched, so compensation cannot be verified before applying — scored conservatively with the rate recorded as null.
reasons.contact_access: No published program email; sign-up runs through the official ambassador page into Aspire.
reasons.credibility: Certified B Corporation founded in Vancouver in 2018 with a lifetime suitcase warranty and premium positioning — top-tier travel-brand credibility.
reasons.niche_fit: Premium minimalist luggage and travel bags — a core travel UGC category with strong visual appeal.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open creator sign-up via the official Brand Ambassadors page for US/Canada creators, though the long-term paid ambassador tier is invite-only.
reasons.ugc_evidence: An official creator recruitment page plus a documented UGC channel for nano/micro-influencers in Aspire's case study, alongside the Awin affiliate listing.
